t.why: Its tourism and finance are tightly bound to the US economy.
t.rel: Close to Florida, most of its tourists come from the United States. Migrants arriving by boat from neighboring Haiti are a major issue. It is a Caribbean Community member.
t.know: The island where Columbus first landed in 1492 is thought to be one of the Bahamas.
t.etext: Tourism is most of the economy, with many visitors from the United States. It is also a low-tax offshore finance center. Hurricane damage is a big risk.
